recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home, then the facts that make it true.

en.primary_text: This is a local Class A driving role built around your life at home. You return home daily, and you earn $31.00 per hour while doing it. If you hold a Class A CDL and want to stay close to home, we want to hear from you.
en.headline: Local Class A, $31/hr.

es.hook: A casa cada día, de verdad.
